DiagnosticsStateEvidence: Configuration absent and no current-process Phase3 trace; app was restarted after disabling
CacheState: Warm/uncontrolled; no global or app cache flush
Crop: FileList bounds contained in experimental UIA window; exact PID/path/starttime and foreground HWND checked before and after capture
Detector: At least 80% of 144 interior points match expected RGB quadrant colors within tolerance 55; generic icon source changes are not treated as thumbnails
Timing: Stopwatch from before ValuePattern.SetValue to completed screen sample classification; lower bound is previous classified sample, or zero before first sample
Observer: polls.csv retains UIA query, capture and detector durations; sampling and image-save overhead are part of observation; no overhead subtraction
Evidence: Screen pixels confirm synthetic thumbnail content in sampled visible area, but do not measure exact display scanout/present frame timestamps
ViewportDefinition: Fully contained Picture rectangles associated with manifest ItemName; initial visible count must remain constant per repetition
VisibilityLimitation: Foreground guard prevents unrelated foreground content; incidental always-on-top overlays are not enumerated; pattern matching will fail rather than count their generic pixels
NativeInterop: Uses existing CsWin32 GetForegroundWindow through reflection only in offline tooling; introduces no new native declarations
